Chennai, India • pandiperumal75@yahoo.com • 984015691 • linkedin.com/in/pandi-perumal-93a2a1a2

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Results-driven Technical Project Manager and PMP-certified delivery leader with 10 years of relevant experience and overall 15 years experience in digital payments and banking platforms — including cross-functional programs across both Waterfall and Agile delivery models. Proven ability to govern multi-million-dollar budgets, manage distributed teams of 25+, and drive delivery predictability from 65% to 95%. Combines deep technical fluency in .NET, SQL, cloud, and DevOps with strong program governance expertise: RAID management, change control, EVM, scope baselines, and stakeholder reporting. Recognized for bridging engineering and business strategy — translating complex technical work into executive-level visibility while enabling teams to deliver high-quality outcomes consistently.

KEY CAREER HIGHLIGHTS



Improved release predictability from 65% → 95% through Agile governance, delivery cadence, and flow metrics (lead time, cycle time, throughput)

Reduced critical production defects by 40% by embedding QA into delivery workflows via Definition of Done and continuous validation

Cut lead time by 15% through WIP limiting, backlog readiness discipline, and Lean value stream optimization

Reduced cycle time by 30% by removing systemic impediments and streamlining end-to-end delivery workflows

Delivered application performance improvements via SQL schema redesign, indexing, and query optimization

Managed hybrid budgets across Fixed Price and T&M contracts — WBS-based baselines for FP, burn rate & cap governance for T&M — with earned value tracking and formal change control

TECHNICAL PROJECT MANAGER STRENGTHS

Dual-Mode Delivery Leadership: Equally proficient in Waterfall (WBS, CPM, EVM, Gantt, RAID logs, stage-gate governance) and Agile (SAFe, Scrum, Kanban, PI Planning, flow-based forecasting) — adapts methodology to project complexity and stakeholder context.

Technical Depth: 8+ years as developer and tech lead in .NET, SQL Server, and banking middleware — enables meaningful conversations with architects, DevOps engineers, and platform teams; reviews technical risks with credibility.

Cloud & Data Platform Awareness: Hands-on exposure to Azure (AKS, Azure Data Factory, Azure DevOps), Databricks, Snowflake, Docker/Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and microservices migration patterns (Debezium CDC, Apache Kafka) — bridges technical delivery and project governance across cloud-native and data engineering programs.

Budget & Financial Governance: Manages Fixed Price (FP) and Time & Material (T&M) contracts — develops WBS- based cost baselines for FP engagements with locked scope and contingency reserves; applies T&M controls with burn rate monitoring, cap management, and scope change governance. Monitors cost variance (CV), CPI/SPI, and drives budget approvals through CAB and steering committee governance.

Risk & Dependency Management: Maintains structured RAID logs, conducts risk response planning (avoid/transfer/mitigate/accept), and proactively manages cross-team dependencies across distributed squads. • Stakeholder & Executive Reporting: Designs data-driven dashboards and governance reports providing real-time

delivery visibility to senior leadership, steering committees, and client stakeholders.

AI-Augmented Delivery: Leverages Generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) for project planning acceleration, automated risk summarization, sprint reporting, and delivery forecasting — quantifiably improving PM efficiency.

Project Management & Governance

Agile & Delivery Leadership

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Technical Project Manager / Agile Coach / Lead Scrum Master FIS Global — Chennai, India | Digital Payments & Prepaid Card Platform

Apr 2021 – Feb 2026

Project & Program Delivery Leadership



Led end-to-end delivery lifecycle (initiation through closure) for platform programs using Waterfall/hybrid methodologies; identified and mitigated program risks proactively while aligning cross-functional stakeholders — business, engineering, compliance — on scope, priorities, and change decisions.

Managed program schedules in MS Project and Azure DevOps, applying Critical Path Method (CPM) and schedule variance analysis to protect milestones; resolved resource and priority conflicts across squads and third-party vendors through structured trade-off negotiation and recovery planning.

Governed WBS-based cost baselines for Fixed Price engagements and burn-rate/cap controls for T&M contracts; managed budget and scope risk through formal change control, negotiating cost-scope-timeline trade-offs with stakeholders and steering committees.



Facilitated lessons-learned and post-implementation reviews with cross-functional teams, identifying systemic risk patterns and delivery conflicts, and institutionalizing findings as process improvements adopted across future programs.

Delivered executive-level risk dashboards and escalation briefings, translating technical and delivery risk into business impact for senior leadership; managed stakeholder expectations and resolved conflicting priorities across 3 concurrent digital product workstreams.



Partnered with architecture and engineering teams across the SDLC for enterprise web application delivery — resolving design trade-offs between technical and business stakeholders, managing integration risk, and driving alignment on scalability and platform standards.

Agile & Program Delivery

Led end-to-end Agile delivery for a portfolio of FIS prepaid card products across 3 Scrum teams (25+ members), resolving cross-team conflicts and aligning competing priorities to improve release predictability from 65% to 95%. • Forecasted sprint costs using story points, historical velocity, and management reserve; negotiated budget burn and variance trade-offs with steering committees on a bi-weekly cadence to keep delivery within approved guardrails.

•

Identified and mitigated program-level risks and cross-team dependencies, resolving scope conflicts through formal change control — minimizing delivery delays and stakeholder escalations.

Partnered with Product Owners to resolve backlog prioritization conflicts and align stakeholders on trade-offs, driving backlog readiness and acceptance criteria quality that delivered a 30% cycle time reduction.

Reduced critical production defects by 40% by resolving quality-vs-speed conflicts between delivery and QA teams — embedding Definition of Done and continuous validation into the delivery workflow.

Built Jira-based delivery and risk dashboards, proactively surfacing delivery risk to stakeholders and audit teams and enabling early conflict resolution before issues escalated.

Governed risk and stakeholder alignment across a monolith-to-microservices migration on Azure (Debezium CDC, Apache Kafka, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Snowflake) — resolving technical and priority conflicts across platform, data, and infrastructure squads to keep the program on track.

Applied working knowledge of SQL Server and Oracle to assess data and integration risk for large-scale prepaid card and core banking applications — bridging technical and business stakeholders and resolving conflicting requirements between engineering and product teams.

Aligned squad delivery goals to business OKRs, facilitating quarterly objective-setting with product leadership and resolving conflicting departmental priorities; tracked key results and reported OKR progress in steering committee reviews.

Leveraged AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot) for risk summarization, stakeholder reporting, and delivery forecasting — accelerating risk identification and freeing time for higher-value stakeholder and conflict management.

Product Owner (SAFe) FIS Global — Chennai, India

Apr 2020 – Mar 2021

Owned and prioritized the product backlog for FIS prepaid card platform, aligning features with business strategy, customer value, and technical feasibility.

Translated stakeholder requirements into well-defined user stories with acceptance criteria; led backlog refinement, sprint planning, and sprint review ceremonies.

Collaborated with architects and engineering teams to evaluate build vs. buy decisions and assess technical dependencies on the product roadmap.

Validated delivered features through sprint reviews and UAT cycles; monitored release readiness against the Definition of Done.

Project Manager / Scrum Master (SAFe) FIS Global — Chennai, India

Apr 2015 – Mar 2020

Managed 2–3 Agile squads (8–10 members each) delivering digital payments and core banking features; improved release predictability from ~60% to ~90%.

Owned project plans, risk logs, and stakeholder communication; reported project status and escalated issues to program managers and business sponsors.

Partnered with Architecture and DevOps teams to enable CI/CD adoption, automated testing pipelines, and faster



release cycles. Introduced data-driven delivery metrics (velocity trends, sprint goal success rate, defect leakage) — enabling informed planning and stakeholder confidence.

Facilitated structured retrospectives with measurable action items, improving team efficiency and reducing recurring delivery issues.

Technical Lead – Application Development FIS Global — Chennai, India

Apr 2011 – Mar 2015

Architected and led development of .NET-based online and batch applications for prepaid card and banking platforms.

Designed SQL Server schemas, stored procedures, and indexes; performed advanced query optimization and execution plan analysis — significantly reducing response times.

Owned coding standards, technical governance, and application architecture for a team of 6 developers. • Managed technical debt reduction, system modernization, and CI/CD pipeline integration with DevOps teams.

Senior Programmer – Application Development FIS Global — Chennai, India

Feb 2007 – Mar 2011

Developed and maintained prepaid banking application features including online modules, batch jobs, and backend services.

Supported application migrations, production deployments, and post-release support across multiple release cycles. • Analysed and resolved application defects and enhancement requests across development and testing phases.

CERTIFICATIONS

Project Management Professional (PMP) — PMI • Certified Scrum Master (CSM) — Scrum Alliance • ICP-ACC Agile Coach — ICAgile

SAFe Agilist (SA) — Scaled Agile Inc. • SAFe Scrum Master (SSM) — Scaled Agile Inc.

EDUCATION

Executive MBA — Cloud Computing & AI, NIBM Global, Chennai • MBA in Project Management, Alagappa University, Karaikudi • M.Sc. in Information Technology, Annamalai University, Chidambaram • B.Com, Madurai Kamaraj University, Madurai

PERSONAL DETAILS

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Technical Project Manager / Agile Coach / Lead Scrum Master FIS Global — Chennai, India | Digital Payments & Prepaid Card Platform
Apr 2021 – Feb 2026
Project & Program Delivery Leadership

Led end-to-end delivery lifecycle (initiation through closure) for platform programs using Waterfall/hybrid methodologies; identified and mitigated program risks proactively while aligning cross-functional stakeholders — business, engineering, compliance — on scope, priorities, and change decisions.
Managed program schedules in MS Project and Azure DevOps, applying Critical Path Method (CPM) and schedule variance analysis to protect milestones; resolved resource and priority conflicts across squads and third-party vendors through structured trade-off negotiation and recovery planning.
Governed WBS-based cost baselines for Fixed Price engagements and burn-rate/cap controls for T&M contracts; managed budget and scope risk through formal change control, negotiating cost-scope-timeline trade-offs with stakeholders and steering committees.

Facilitated lessons-learned and post-implementation reviews with cross-functional teams, identifying systemic risk patterns and delivery conflicts, and institutionalizing findings as process improvements adopted across future programs.
Delivered executive-level risk dashboards and escalation briefings, translating technical and delivery risk into business impact for senior leadership; managed stakeholder expectations and resolved conflicting priorities across 3 concurrent digital product workstreams.

Partnered with architecture and engineering teams across the SDLC for enterprise web application delivery — resolving design trade-offs between technical and business stakeholders, managing integration risk, and driving alignment on scalability and platform standards.
Agile & Program Delivery
Led end-to-end Agile delivery for a portfolio of FIS prepaid card products across 3 Scrum teams (25+ members), resolving cross-team conflicts and aligning competing priorities to improve release predictability from 65% to 95%. • Forecasted sprint costs using story points, historical velocity, and management reserve; negotiated budget burn and variance trade-offs with steering committees on a bi-weekly cadence to keep delivery within approved guardrails.
•
Identified and mitigated program-level risks and cross-team dependencies, resolving scope conflicts through formal change control — minimizing delivery delays and stakeholder escalations.
Partnered with Product Owners to resolve backlog prioritization conflicts and align stakeholders on trade-offs, driving backlog readiness and acceptance criteria quality that delivered a 30% cycle time reduction.
Reduced critical production defects by 40% by resolving quality-vs-speed conflicts between delivery and QA teams — embedding Definition of Done and continuous validation into the delivery workflow.
Built Jira-based delivery and risk dashboards, proactively surfacing delivery risk to stakeholders and audit teams and enabling early conflict resolution before issues escalated.
Governed risk and stakeholder alignment across a monolith-to-microservices migration on Azure (Debezium CDC, Apache Kafka, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Snowflake) — resolving technical and priority conflicts across platform, data, and infrastructure squads to keep the program on track.
Applied working knowledge of SQL Server and Oracle to assess data and integration risk for large-scale prepaid card and core banking applications — bridging technical and business stakeholders and resolving conflicting requirements between engineering and product teams.
Aligned squad delivery goals to business OKRs, facilitating quarterly objective-setting with product leadership and resolving conflicting departmental priorities; tracked key results and reported OKR progress in steering committee reviews.
Leveraged AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot) for risk summarization, stakeholder reporting, and delivery forecasting — accelerating risk identification and freeing time for higher-value stakeholder and conflict management.
Product Owner (SAFe) FIS Global — Chennai, India
Apr 2020 – Mar 2021
Owned and prioritized the product backlog for FIS prepaid card platform, aligning features with business strategy, customer value, and technical feasibility.
Translated stakeholder requirements into well-defined user stories with acceptance criteria; led backlog refinement, sprint planning, and sprint review ceremonies.
Collaborated with architects and engineering teams to evaluate build vs. buy decisions and assess technical dependencies on the product roadmap.
Validated delivered features through sprint reviews and UAT cycles; monitored release readiness against the Definition of Done.
Project Manager / Scrum Master (SAFe) FIS Global — Chennai, India
Apr 2015 – Mar 2020
Managed 2–3 Agile squads (8–10 members each) delivering digital payments and core banking features; improved release predictability from ~60% to ~90%.
Owned project plans, risk logs, and stakeholder communication; reported project status and escalated issues to program managers and business sponsors.
Partnered with Architecture and DevOps teams to enable CI/CD adoption, automated testing pipelines, and faster

release cycles. Introduced data-driven delivery metrics (velocity trends, sprint goal success rate, defect leakage) — enabling informed planning and stakeholder confidence.
Facilitated structured retrospectives with measurable action items, improving team efficiency and reducing recurring delivery issues.
Technical Lead – Application Development FIS Global — Chennai, India
Apr 2011 – Mar 2015
Architected and led development of .NET-based online and batch applications for prepaid card and banking platforms.
Designed SQL Server schemas, stored procedures, and indexes; performed advanced query optimization and execution plan analysis — significantly reducing response times.
Owned coding standards, technical governance, and application architecture for a team of 6 developers. • Managed technical debt reduction, system modernization, and CI/CD pipeline integration with DevOps teams.
Senior Programmer – Application Development FIS Global — Chennai, India
Feb 2007 – Mar 2011
Developed and maintained prepaid banking application features including online modules, batch jobs, and backend services.
Supported application migrations, production deployments, and post-release support across multiple release cycles. • Analysed and resolved application defects and enhancement requests across development and testing phases.
